literal: On wushen day Yelü Dashinu had cradle attendant grace; edict ordered entry into the clan registry.
idiomatic: On wushen day Yelü Dashinu had cradle attendant grace; an edict ordered him entered into the clan registry.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day, provided relief for the Yemizhi tribe.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on jiayin day, relief was provided for the Yemizhi tribe.

literal: Fifth month, on the gengshen new moon, took summer retreat along Yangliu Lake.
idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat along Yangliu Lake.

literal: That month, the Empress Dowager returned government to the Emperor and personally guarded Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: That month the Empress Dowager returned government to the Emperor and personally guarded Qing Mausoleum.

literal: Sixth month, on jihai day, made Xiao Pugu Southern Court Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On jihai day of the sixth month Xiao Pugu was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the wuzi new moon, the Emperor began to personally administer government; appointed Yelü Shuzheng, Liu Liufu, Yelü Mu, and Bo Kejiu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the Emperor began to personally administer government; Yelü Shuzheng, Liu Liufu, Yelü Mu, and Bo Kejiu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: On renchen day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On renchen day the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiwei day, halted at Zhonghui River.
idiomatic: On jiwei day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Zhonghui River.

literal: Twelfth month, Song dispatched Duan Shaolian and Du Renzan to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year; Yang Xie and Li Shouzhong to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Song sent Duan Shaolian and Du Renzan to congratulate New Year's Day of the coming year, and Yang Xie and Li Shouzhong to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on gengyin day, went to Yemizhi territory.
idiomatic: In the fourth year, on gengyin day of the first spring month, the court went to Yemizhi territory.

literal: Third month, on the yiyou new moon, installed Empress Xiao.
idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon of the third month Empress Xiao was installed.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on the jiayin new moon, went to Cool Pass.
idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the fourth summer month the court went to Cool Pass.

literal: Fifth month, on gengzi day, took summer retreat at Sanshui source.
idiomatic: On gengzi day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Sanshui source.

literal: Sixth month, on the guichou new moon, the imperial prince Baoxinnu was born.
idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month the imperial prince Baoxinnu was born.

literal: Appointed Yelü Xin, Lü Shizong, Xiao Gun, and Guo Kui chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: Yelü Xin, Lü Shizong, Xiao Gun, and Guo Kui were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the renwu new moon, hunted at Black Ridge.
idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Black Ridge.

literal: Ninth month, on yiyou day, halted at Changning Marsh.
idiomatic: On yiyou day of the ninth month the court halted at Changning Marsh.

literal: Winter, tenth month, went to Prince City.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court went to Prince City.

literal: Eleventh month, on renwu day, changed Nanjing supreme commander office to marshal's headquarters.
idiomatic: On renwu day of the eleventh month Nanjing supreme commander office was renamed marshal's headquarters.

literal: On yiyou day, performed firewood-and-script rites at White Ridge; general amnesty.
idiomatic: On yiyou day the firewood-and-script rites were performed at White Ridge and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: Added Esteemed Father Yelü Xinning and Political Affairs Commissioner Yelü Qiuhan the title Elder Minister Assisting Accomplished Merit.
idiomatic: Esteemed Father Yelü Xinning and Political Affairs Commissioner Yelü Qiuhan were granted the title Elder Minister Assisting Accomplished Merit.

literal: Twelfth month, on guichou day, edict ordered artillery, crossbow, bow, and sword troops of all armies to drill on schedule.
idiomatic: On guichou day of the twelfth month an edict ordered artillery, crossbow, bow, and sword troops of all armies to drill on schedule.

literal: On gengshen day Song dispatched Zheng Jian, Chai Yifan, Yang Rihua, and Zhang Shiyu to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Song sent Zheng Jian, Chai Yifan, Yang Rihua, and Zhang Shiyu to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival and New Year's Day.

literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, on jiashen day, went to Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: In the fifth year, on jiashen day of the first spring month, the court went to Yu'er Marsh.

literal: Privy Commissioner Xiao Yanning requested changing maternal uncle Yi Chamber Lesser Merit Tent Chang Shi to general; approved.
idiomatic: Privy Commissioner Xiao Yanning requested that maternal uncle Yi Chamber Lesser Merit Tent Chang Shi be made a general; approval was granted.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on gengshen day, made Prince of Lu Zhage Southern Chancellor and Chongde Palace commissioner Yelü Maliu tiyin.
idiomatic: On gengshen day of the fourth summer month Prince of Lu Zhage was appointed Southern Chancellor and Chongde Palace commissioner Yelü Maliu tiyin.

literal: On jiazi day, visited younger imperial brother-in-law Xiao Wuqu's residence; floated wine cups on winding water and composed poetry.
idiomatic: On jiazi day the court visited younger imperial brother-in-law Xiao Wuqu's residence, floated wine cups on winding water, and composed poetry.

literal: On dingmao day, promulgated newly fixed regulations.
idiomatic: On dingmao day newly fixed regulations were promulgated.

literal: On jisi day, the Emperor and ministers divided into teams and played cuju.
idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor and ministers divided into teams and played cuju.

literal: Fifth month, on jiawu day, made a southern tour.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the fifth month the court made a southern tour.

literal: On dingwei day, went to Hutu White Mountain for the summer retreat.
idiomatic: On dingwei day the court went to Hutu White Mountain for the summer retreat.

literal: On gengshen day, visited Northern Court great king Gao Shi's mobile tent and paid respects at the ancestral tent; bestowed silver and silk.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court visited Northern Court great king Gao Shi's mobile tent and paid respects at the ancestral tent, bestowing silver and silk.

literal: On renxu day, edict ordered repair of Nanjing palace gates and government offices.
idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered repair of Nanjing palace gates and government offices.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinchou day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On xinchou day of the seventh autumn month prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Yelü Baba falsely accused his younger brother Hange of plotting to kill him; the relevant offices memorialized that counter-penalty applied.
idiomatic: Yelü Baba falsely accused his younger brother Hange of plotting to kill him; the relevant offices memorialized that counter-penalty applied.

literal: At execution, his younger brother wept and pleaded: "Your subject has only one elder brother; I beg his life be spared.
idiomatic: At execution his younger brother wept and pleaded: "Your subject has only one elder brother; I beg his life be spared.

literal: " The Emperor took pity and granted it.
idiomatic: " The Emperor took pity and granted the request.

literal: Ninth month, on guisi day, hunted at Yellow Flower Mountain; captured thirty-six bears; rewarded hunters in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On guisi day of the ninth month the court hunted at Yellow Flower Mountain, captured thirty-six bears, and rewarded the hunters in differing amounts.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingwei day, visited Nanjing.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the tenth winter month the court visited Nanjing.

literal: On xinhai day, granted partial amnesty to prisoners within Qijin Prefecture.
idiomatic: On xinhai day a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners within Qijin Prefecture.

literal: On renzi day, attended Yuanhe Hall; tested jinshi at court with "Essay on Shooting Thirty-six Bears in a Day" and "Poem on the Journey to Yan"; granted jinshi rank to forty-nine including Feng Li and Zhao Hui.
idiomatic: On renzi day the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall, tested jinshi at court with "Essay on Shooting Thirty-six Bears in a Day" and "Poem on the Journey to Yan," and granted jinshi rank to forty-nine including Feng Li and Zhao Hui.

literal: Made Feng Li Right Remonstrance Censor; Zhao Hui and below all Crown Prince Middle Attendants; bestowed crimson robes and silver fish tally; then held a great feast.
idiomatic: Feng Li was appointed Right Remonstrance Censor; Zhao Hui and below were all made Crown Prince Middle Attendants; crimson robes and silver fish tally were bestowed, and then a great feast was held.

literal: Court examination of jinshi began from this.
idiomatic: Court examination of jinshi began from this point.

literal: Song dispatched Song Jiao and Wang Shiwen to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Song Jiao and Wang Shiwen to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: On jiazi day, chief minister Zhang Jian and others requested visiting the Ministry of Rites examination yard; feasted until evening then stopped; bestowed goods in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On jiazi day chief minister Zhang Jian and others requested visiting the Ministry of Rites examination yard; they feasted until evening then stopped, and goods were bestowed in differing amounts.

literal: Appointed Yelü Xiang, Zhang Sumin, Yelü Fu, and Wang Ze chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: Yelü Xiang, Zhang Sumin, Yelü Fu, and Wang Ze were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.

literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, on dingchou day, made a western tour.
idiomatic: In the sixth year, on dingchou day of the first spring month, the court made a western tour.

literal: Third month, on wuyin day, made Prince of Qin Xiao Xiaomu Northern Court Privy Commissioner, transferred enfeoffment to King of Wu;
idiomatic: On wuyin day of the third month Prince of Qin Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Privy Commissioner and transferred in enfeoffment to King of Wu;

literal: Prince of Jin Xiao Xiaoxian was made Nanjing regent.
idiomatic: Prince of Jin Xiao Xiaoxian was appointed Nanjing regent.

literal: Summer, fourth month, hunted at Wild Fox Ridge.
idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court hunted at Wild Fox Ridge.

literal: Intercalary month, hunted on the western mountains of Longmen county.
idiomatic: In the intercalary month the court hunted on the western mountains of Longmen county.

literal: Fifth month, on jiyou day, took summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
idiomatic: On jiyou day of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.

literal: Made Yelü Hanba Northern Court great king, Xiao Bage Left yilibi, prince langjun xiangwen Bi Gude linya, and Northern Affairs signatory Yelü Niege jointly signatory of the Inspectorate.
idiomatic: Yelü Hanba was appointed Northern Court great king; Xiao Bage was made Left yilibi; prince langjun xiangwen Bi Gude linya; and Northern Affairs signatory Yelü Niege jointly signatory of the Inspectorate.

literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Because Southern Great King Yelü Xinning had formerly concealed serious criminals and handmaidens' corruption, ordered him beaten with the flat of a sword and stripped of office;
idiomatic: Because Southern Great King Yelü Xinning had formerly concealed serious criminals and handmaidens involved in corruption, he was ordered beaten with the flat of a sword and stripped of office;

literal: the intendant and handmaidens, convicted of complicity, were all sentenced to death; edict pardoned them.
idiomatic: the intendant and handmaidens, convicted of complicity, were all sentenced to death; an edict pardoned them.

literal: On bingchen day, made Yelü Xinning Southwestern Route pacification commissioner.
idiomatic: On bingchen day Yelü Xinning was appointed Southwestern Route pacification commissioner.

literal: On gengshen day, brought out Flying Dragon stable horses and bestowed on Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern and Southern attendants in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On gengshen day Flying Dragon stable horses were brought out and bestowed on Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan and Northern and Southern attendants in differing amounts.

literal: On guihai day, made Upper Capital regent Yelü Huchuo Southern Great King, Associate Councilor Xiao Zhala Upper Capital regent, Palace Attendant Guan Ning mobile palace deployment director, and Yelü Punu Ningwu Ugu diledu xiangwen.
idiomatic: On guihai day Upper Capital regent Yelü Huchuo was appointed Southern Great King; Associate Councilor Xiao Zhala Upper Capital regent; Palace Attendant Guan Ning mobile palace deployment director; and Yelü Punu Ningwu Ugu diledu xiangwen.

literal: On jiazi day, made Upper Capital regent Yelü Honggu Northern Court great king.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Upper Capital regent Yelü Honggu was appointed Northern Court great king.

literal: Sixth month, on the renshen new moon, made Shanning Palace Front Command inspector, Guard Protector Grand Steward Yelü Hezhu concurrent Changning Palace commissioner, and Xiao Alali, Yelü Wuluwo, Yelü Heshang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao Teli, and Xiao Qiuhande deployment directors of respective palaces.
idiomatic: On the renshen new moon of the sixth month Shanning was appointed Palace Front Command inspector; Guard Protector Grand Steward Yelü Hezhu concurrent Changning Palace commissioner; and Xiao Alali, Yelü Wuluwo, Yelü Heshang, Xiao Hanjianu, Xiao Teli, and Xiao Qiuhande deployment directors of their respective palaces.

literal: The Emperor, tipsy with wine, composed poetry; King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu, Northern Chancellor Xiao Saba, and others all joined in harmony; only at midnight did they stop.
idiomatic: The Emperor, tipsy with wine, composed poetry; King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu, Northern Chancellor Xiao Saba, and others all joined in with matching verses; only at midnight did they stop.

literal: On jimao day, sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On jimao day sacrifices were offered to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On guiwei day, bestowed commission on Southern Court great king Yelü Huchuo; the Emperor personally drafted the appointment edict wording and also bestowed poetry to honor him.
idiomatic: On guiwei day commission was bestowed on Southern Court great king Yelü Huchuo; the Emperor personally drafted the appointment edict wording and also bestowed poetry to honor him.

literal: On bingshen day, made Northern Court great king Hou Shen Nanjing military governor.
idiomatic: On bingshen day Northern Court great king Hou Shen was appointed Nanjing military governor.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinchou new moon, because Northern and Southern Privy Council prisons were empty, rewards were granted in differing amounts.
idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the seventh autumn month, because Northern and Southern Privy Council prisons were empty, rewards were granted in differing amounts.

literal: On renyin day, because Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan had a son born, bestowed poetry and precious curios; partial amnesty below capital crimes.
idiomatic: On renyin day, because Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan had a son born, poetry and precious curios were bestowed and a partial amnesty was granted below capital crimes.

literal: On guimao day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On guimao day the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Eighth month, on jimao day, Northern Privy Council reported Yueji tribe people suffered under their chieftain Kunzhang's lawlessness and many fled;
idiomatic: On jimao day of the eighth month the Northern Privy Council reported that Yueji tribe people suffered under their chieftain Kunzhang's lawlessness and many had fled;

literal: edict abolished Yueji and other Five States chieftains and placed one Khitan military commissioner in command of them.
idiomatic: an edict abolished the chieftains of Yueji and the other Five States and placed them under a single Khitan military commissioner.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on guiyou day, halted at Shibao Ridge.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Shibao Ridge.

literal: Eleventh month, on the jihai new moon, Zubu chieftains came with tribute.
idiomatic: On the jihai new moon of the eleventh month Zubu chieftains came with tribute.

literal: On xinhai day, made Khitan mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hui Southern Court Privy Commissioner.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Khitan mobile palace deployment director Xiao Hui was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner.

literal: On renzi day, made Guan Ning Southern Court Privy Commissioner, Xiao Saogu deployment director of all mobile palaces, Yelü Lizhi Southern mobile palace deputy deployment director, Xiao Alali Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen, and Yelü Hezhu Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.
idiomatic: On renzi day Guan Ning was appointed Southern Court Privy Commissioner; Xiao Saogu deployment director of all mobile palaces; Yelü Lizhi Southern mobile palace deputy deployment director; Xiao Alali Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Yelü Hezhu Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.

literal: On gengshen day, visited Jin State Princess's mobile tent to inquire after her illness.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court visited Jin State Princess's mobile tent to inquire after her illness.

literal: Enfeoffed imperial prince Hongji as King of Liang.
idiomatic: Imperial prince Hongji was enfeoffed as King of Liang.

literal: Twelfth month, made Yang Jie Zhongshun Army military commissioner.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yang Jie was appointed Zhongshun Army military commissioner.

literal: Dispatched Yelü Wo, Qin Jian, Yelü De, and Cui Jifang to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: Yelü Wo, Qin Jian, Yelü De, and Cui Jifang were dispatched to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.

literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on the wuxu new moon, Song dispatched Gao Ruone, Xia Yuanzheng, Xie Jiang, and Zhang Maoshi to congratulate New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the wuxu new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Gao Ruone, Xia Yuanzheng, Xie Jiang, and Zhang Maoshi to congratulate New Year's Day and the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: On xinchou day, went to Huntong River.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the court went to Huntong River.

literal: Second month, on gengwu day, went to Chunzhou.
idiomatic: On gengwu day of the second month the court went to Chunzhou.

literal: On yihai day, halted at East River.
idiomatic: On yihai day the court halted at East River.

literal: On dingchou day, Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On dingchou day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On renwu day, visited the Five Compounds to inspect hawks and falcons.
idiomatic: On renwu day the court visited the Five Compounds to inspect hawks and falcons.

literal: On yiyou day, dispatched envoys to Qingzhou to inquire after the Empress Dowager's health.
idiomatic: On yiyou day envoys were dispatched to Qingzhou to inquire after the Empress Dowager's health.

literal: Third month, on the wuxu new moon, visited Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan's mobile tent.
idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the third month the court visited Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan's mobile tent.

literal: On renyin day, went to Puhe Marsh.
idiomatic: On renyin day the court went to Puhe Marsh.

literal: On xinhai day, Xia State sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: On xinhai day Xia State sent envoys with tribute.

literal: On jiayin day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiayin day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Summer, fourth month, on jisi day, because Princess Xingping died, dispatched Northern Court recipient Yelü Shucheng with an edict to question Xia King Li Yuanhao; the Princess had been at odds with Yuanhao in life, and in death the reason was demanded.
idiomatic: On jisi day of the fourth summer month, because Princess Xingping had died, Northern Court recipient Yelü Shucheng was dispatched with an edict to question Xia King Li Yuanhao, as the Princess had been at odds with Yuanhao in life and the reason was to be demanded upon her death.

literal: On jimao day, hunted at White Horse Bend.
idiomatic: On jimao day the court hunted at White Horse Bend.

literal: On jiashen day, shot rabbits at Xindian Marsh.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the court shot rabbits at Xindian Marsh.

literal: On yiwei day, hunted at Jin Mountain; dispatched the Yang family to present deer-tail velvet to Da'an Palace.
idiomatic: On yiwei day the court hunted at Jin Mountain and dispatched the Yang family to present deer-tail velvet to Da'an Palace.

literal: Sixth month, on yihai day, attended the Cool Hall and tested jinshi; granted rank to fifty-five including Xing Pengnian and below.
idiomatic: On yihai day of the sixth month the Emperor attended the Cool Hall, tested jinshi, and granted rank to fifty-five including Xing Pengnian and below.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jiachen day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On jiachen day of the seventh autumn month prisoners were reviewed.

literal: On yisi day, Zubu chieftain Tuntugusi came to court.
idiomatic: On yisi day Zubu chieftain Tuntugusi came to court.

literal: On wushen day, went to Black Ridge.
idiomatic: On wushen day the court went to Black Ridge.

literal: Ninth month, on dingwei day, halted at Ping Marsh.
idiomatic: On dingwei day of the ninth month the court halted at Ping Marsh.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiazi new moon, crossed the Liao River.
idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon of the tenth winter month the court crossed the Liao River.

literal: On bingyin day, halted at White Horse Marsh.
idiomatic: On bingyin day the court halted at White Horse Marsh.
